C1314.title: Threat Actors Use Reverse Proxy for AiTM Attacks to Bypass MFA
C1314.summary: Cisco Talos researchers discovered that cybercriminals are using reverse proxies to conduct adversary-in-the-middle attacks, successfully bypassing MFA. Attackers position themselves between the victim and the legitimate website, intercepting login credentials and post-MFA authentication cookies.
